result:
I fixed the one rule break in the new code: the component was calling `useNotifications`. I did not run tests, lint, or the app, as requested.

- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/comments/api/update-comment.ts`**: `useUpdateComment` now calls `useNotifications` and shows the "Comment Updated" success notification in `onSuccess`. The import is from `@/components/ui/notifications`.
- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx`**: removed the `useNotifications` import and the inline `mutationConfig.onSuccess`. The component now just calls `useUpdateComment({ discussionId })`.

The query key rule already held. `update-comment.ts` invalidates with `getInfiniteCommentsQueryOptions(discussionId).queryKey`, and the only literal key is inside `infiniteQueryOptions` in `get-comments.ts`, so I left it alone.

The existing `create-comment.tsx` and `delete-comment.tsx` also call `useNotifications` in components. I did not touch them because they are not part of your uncommitted change, but they break the same rule and could be moved the same way.

Nothing was committed or pushed.
